description: Retrieve a Lemma document generator by generatorId via GET /v1/doc-generators/{generatorId}. A generator describes how a class of source documents is produced (e.g., what fields a 'KYC-v2' issuer must populate). Returns GeneratorMeta { generatorId, schema, description?, language?, source?: { type: 'url', uri }, inputsSpec?, outputsSpec? }. Each generator is bound to one schema. Use this when onboarding a new issuer or auditing how an existing schema is being populated.

generatorId.description: Generator ID. Each generator is bound to a single schema and describes how source documents are produced. Registered via POST /v1/doc-generators. NOTE: this matches the OpenAPI field name `generatorId`, not a generic `id`.

name: lemma_get_generator

inputsSpec.description: Specification of fields the issuer must populate.

outputsSpec.description: Specification of fields the generator produces.

schema.description: Schema ID this generator is bound to (1:1 binding).

source.description: Reference to the generator's source code.
